authority: Parent-approved bounded postcapture diagnostic closure; no additional audit_run or STRICT.accounting call, no new totals or observations.
functions: collect, corrected_ledger with exact saved context proofs, instrument_original pure reconcile_stream, _original_scope_consequence
purpose: Publish the missing candidate001 original inner/outer diagnostics separately; the eight other rows already retain complete diagnostics. Compare per-thread ledger, warnings, gaps, raw/response identities and capture proof-view hashes to the immutable existing receipt without invoking whole-workflow aggregation.
replay_python_source:
import json,hashlib,types,sys,datetime
from pathlib import Path
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
canon=lambda x:json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
scope_path=Path(sys.argv[1]); expected=sys.argv[2]
assert sha(scope_path.read_bytes())==expected
scope=json.loads(scope_path.read_bytes())
refs=dict(scope['source_sha256'])
for p,h in refs.items():assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==h,p
def compile_pinned(ref,name):
 data=Path(ref['path']).read_bytes();assert sha(data)==ref['sha256']
 m=types.ModuleType(name);m.__file__=ref['path'];exec(compile(data,ref['path'],'exec'),m.__dict__);return m
carry=compile_pinned(scope['carry_helper'],'provenance_only_carry')
ctx=carry.load_context();old=ctx.load_original()
# These guards make an accidental whole-run call a hard failure.
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs):raise AssertionError('whole-workflow accounting forbidden in provenance-only scope')
old.audit_run=forbidden;old.STRICT.accounting=forbidden;ctx.audit_run=forbidden;carry.audit_run=forbidden
receipt=json.loads(Path(scope['receipt']['path']).read_bytes())
saved=receipt['accounting'];entry=receipt['original_entry']
frozen=json.loads(Path(scope['phase_manifest']['path']).read_bytes())
sources=ctx.Sources()
captures,natives=ctx.collect(entry,frozen,Path(scope['sessions_root']),old,sources)
native={'records':{},'compactions':{}}
proofs=saved['compaction_context_derivative']['proofs']
for path,rows,metadata in natives:
 ledger=ctx.corrected_ledger(old,rows,metadata,frozen['model'],frozen['reasoning_effort'],path,[p for p in proofs if p['source']==path])
 for kind in native:
  assert not(native[kind].keys()&ledger[kind].keys())
  native[kind].update(ledger[kind])
wrapped,diagnostics=carry.instrument_original(old)
threads={};gaps=[];warnings=[];raw={};evidence={};checks=[]
expected_captures={c['path']:c for c in saved['corrected_scope']['captures']}
assert len(expected_captures)==len(captures)
for capture in captures:
 app=Path(capture['path']);grace_path=app/'provider-usage-grace.jsonl'
 grace=sources.rows(grace_path) if grace_path.exists() else None
 inv=wrapped(capture['clients'],capture['servers'],grace,native)
 assert not inv['errors'],inv['errors']
 retained=expected_captures[str(app)]
 assert inv['warnings']==retained['warnings']
 assert inv['omitted_compaction_ids']==retained['omitted_compaction_ids']
 assert inv['late_terminal_usage_recoveries']==retained['late_terminal_usage_recoveries']
 assert len(inv['proof_view_server_lines'])==retained['proof_view_server_lines_identity']['count']
 assert sha(canon(inv['proof_view_server_lines']))==retained['proof_view_server_lines_identity']['sha256']
 assert not(threads.keys()&inv['thread_ledger'].keys());threads.update(inv['thread_ledger'])
 gaps.extend(inv['gaps']);warnings.extend({'capture':str(app),**w} for w in inv['warnings'])
 assert not(raw.keys()&inv['raw_responses'].keys());raw.update(inv['raw_responses'])
 for rid,record in inv['raw_responses'].items():
  evidence[rid]={**record,'sources':native['records'][rid]['sources']+[{'path':str(app/'server-to-client.raw'),'server_line':line} for line in inv['response_server_lines'][rid]]}
 diagnostics[-1]['capture']=str(app)
 checks.append({'capture':str(app),'warnings_match':True,'omission_identities_match':True,'late_recoveries_match':True,'proof_view_identity_match':True})
assert threads==saved['corrected_scope']['threads']
assert gaps==saved['measurement']['gap_inventory']['gaps']
assert warnings==saved['warnings']
assert len(raw)==saved['measurement']['gap_inventory']['raw_response_inventory_identity']['count']
assert sha(canon(raw))==saved['measurement']['gap_inventory']['raw_response_inventory_identity']['sha256']
assert len(evidence)==saved['exact_response_evidence']['count']
assert sha(canon(evidence))==saved['exact_response_evidence']['sha256']
unbounded=[g for g in gaps if g['response_count_upper'] is None]
assert len(unbounded)==5 and all(g['proof'] is None for g in unbounded)
observed=json.loads(sources.read(Path(entry['artifact'])/'observation/analysis.json'))
assert len(diagnostics)==len(captures)
outer=carry._original_scope_consequence(wrapped,observed)
sources.finish()
for p,h in sources.hashes.items():assert refs.get(p)==h,p
for p,h in refs.items():assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==h,p
assert sha(scope_path.read_bytes())==expected
print(json.dumps({'schema':'work-leaf-carry-provenance-only-closure-v1','scope_sha256':expected,
 'recorded_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'run_id':entry['run_id'],
 'status':'matched_immutable_numerical_receipt_with_separate_diagnostics',
 'original_receipt':scope['receipt'],'consolidation':scope['consolidation'],
 'frozen_missing_publication_retained':saved['repeated_metadata_derivative'],
 'capture_diagnostics':diagnostics,'original_outer_scope_diagnostic':outer,'capture_checks':checks,
 'exact_matches':{'thread_ledgers':True,'gap_inventory':True,'all_warnings':True,'raw_response_inventory':True,'exact_response_evidence':True},
 'canonical_matched_identities':{k:sha(canon(v)) for k,v in [('thread_ledgers',threads),('gaps',gaps),('warnings',warnings),('raw_responses',raw),('exact_response_evidence',evidence)]},
 'unsupported_interrupted_tails':[{'thread_id':g['thread_id'],'turn_id':g['turn_id'],'response_count_upper':None,'proof':None} for g in unbounded],
 'whole_workflow_audit_run_called':False,'strict_accounting_called':False,'whole_workflow_aggregate_or_bounds_computed':False,
 'numerical_results_or_receipts_replaced':False,'provider_calls':0,'source_sha256':sources.hashes,
 'all_declared_sources_endpoint_unchanged':True,
 'limitation':'Separate postcapture diagnostic replay; cannot make missing original publication present or prove hidden response completeness. Existing unbounded endpoint and original failures remain authority.'
},separators=(',',':')))
